name: Boston Globe
notes: Rolling 72-hour access. Resubmitting the registration form for an existing account is the intended way to re-up it.

name: New York Times
notes: 24-hour pass from a bulk certificate, valid until 2031. Redemption is two GraphQL calls in sequence, mirroring the browser: CheckAccessCode then redeemAccessCode. Sending only the mutation fails with a generic access_code_redemption_error. Needs a cookies.txt exported once from a logged-in browser; NYT's login page is behind DataDome and is never scripted.

name: The Wall Street Journal
notes: Also a treadmill: 3-day access, then 'return to this page and log in as an existing user with the same username and password'. That is the Boston Globe pattern, so it is probably ez_register-able, but partner.wsj.com is a JS app and has not been investigated yet.

name: The Washington Post
notes: Also a treadmill: 7-day access, then 'revisit this page and restart the process'. Not yet investigated.
